result.summary: In 2021 Huang spoke mainly at the April and November GTC keynotes and their press Q&As, and on CNBC. Most of it was product and metaverse talk rather than dated AI forecasts. The only dated forecast I verified on a page is the already-recorded November 2021 claim about EVs and autonomy by 2024. The page for the April 12 keynote was cut off, and the GamesBeat Q&As would not open or were paywalled, so the two April parameter-model claims could not be checked.

reply_text:
I found one dated 2021 claim, and it's one you already have: the November 2021 GTC claim about EVs having substantial self-driving capability by 2024. I found nothing new to add, and the year looks quiet apart from your three recorded claims. I used 10 of the 12 searches and all 6 page openings.

- **The EV claim:** I read it on Nvidia's own blog post wrapping up the keynote, which was written by Nvidia staff rather than being a transcript. The post says: "Everything that moves will be autonomous—fully or mostly autonomous, Huang said. 'By 2024, the vast majority of new EVs will have substantial AV capability,' he added." The other quotes in that post are descriptions of what was announced, not dated forecasts.
- **The April 12, 2021 claims (multi-trillion and 100-trillion parameter models):** I could not check these. The rev.com page I opened claims to be the full keynote transcript but stops after the opening section, around the graphics portion. Neither parameter-model claim appears in that part.
- **GamesBeat press Q&As:** These printed Q&As are the most likely place for more of his own words, but I couldn't read them. The April 2021 GTC Q&A page would not open. The Computex 2021 Q&A and an undated Huang interview page (published date unknown) opened but are behind a paywall and showed only the introduction.
- **CNBC "Mad Money" interview (Nov 19, 2021):** He talks about simulating factories and power grids in Nvidia's "omniverse" and possible savings, but gives no date or time span, so it doesn't qualify.
- **No AGI timing in 2021:** The three fixed searches returned almost entirely 2024–2026 news, and nothing I found from 2021 is about when AGI or superintelligence arrives.

The two unused searches would be best spent on a full transcript of the April 12, 2021 keynote. That would let you check the two parameter-model claims against his own words.
